text:
Hi everyone! Need some advice from any Brits or anyone who has upgraded to A5.

​I’m British, my husband is Israeli, and we got married in Cyprus in June. I’m currently on a B1 visa.

​We now have an appointment scheduled for the A5 interview. The clerk asked for apostilled proof that my status has been updated to "Married" back in the UK, to bring with me to the interview.

​Since the UK has no central population registry and doesn't record foreign marriages, this document doesn't exist.  

​Has anyone faced this request? I would love to know how you overcame it or what evidence you provided that Misrad accepted! 

Thanks so much! 🙏
